author: zaidms0987
body:
Hey guys, 
This is zaidms0987 (quite obvious), and I've just been banned for the 4th time on here (all on alts, but never on my main). I've appealed all of those on skype, but I decided to try the appeal system this time. Although I do not have any evidence, I was not aimbotting, and really theres no reason for me to do so on a server which I have been a part of for 2 years (havent used the forums for around a year now). Not sure what else I am supposed to say here, but I hope you understand and choose to unban me (hopefully less than 17 years time).
Thanks for reading this.
